metadata.scope: Frozen GovInfo DCPD eligible corpus, January 20, 2025 through September 11, 2026. All 53 broad Kim/North Korea/DPRK discovery hits adjudicated. No live external sources added.
metadata.unit: One distinct official source communication × Kim Jong Un, regardless of number of mentions/positive or negative clauses. State-only references remain excluded from personal numerator and denominator.
metadata.rubric: Main broad favorable union is first six flags. Communication quality alone, ceremony, knowing someone, state strengths, and inferred intent do not establish personal praise. Current affinity permits expressly carried-forward relationship contexts; purely historical affinity alone is excluded. Explicit trust requires a direct assertion, not safety inferred from relationship. All flags may overlap.
scope_limitations: This is complete review of the supplied 53 discovery hits, not a claim of all remarks Trump made in every medium.

A mechanical alias cross-check over all 1,051 eligible frozen records found no additional records matching Kim, Kim-Jong/Jong-Un, North Korea, DPRK, or Rocket Man aliases outside the 53. Pronoun-only documents without any searchable target anchor may remain undiscovered.
Frozen archive coverage, missing speech/video transcription, joint authorship, and acquisition limits from METHOD.md still apply. No live web validation or motive/causal inference was added.
Semantic coding is AI review, not a human-validated gold standard. Literal source verification checks transcription, indices and attribution, not the correctness of every semantic judgment.
Direct-question/voluntary labels describe the observed context only; no opportunity denominator or claim that other records were opportunities is inferred.
metadata.negative_sensitivity: DCPD-202600233 ¶347 receives literal conduct-negative but may function ironically or approvingly. Report 1 including it and 0 unambiguous personal condemnation excluding it.
metadata.trust_sensitivity: DCPD-202500870 ¶134–135 expresses safety grounded in relationship; strict explicit_trust remains false.
metadata.deduplication: Unique DCPD IDs are units. Repeated mentions within an ID count once. Distinct same-day events are retained. This table does not pool social posts or syndicated repetitions.
metadata.cross_target_comparison_caution: Use raw category counts over identical dates unless personal-target inclusion denominators have been harmonized across leaders. Kim 19/22 is descriptive only, not an exposure-adjusted comparative ranking.
